messages:
cara-recruiter: quick one 0%: candidate (Marco R) accepted offer in EMEA band but asked to relocate to SF before start. Original offer = EUR75k base + 5k EUR sign-on + 0.15% eq. Hiring manager wants to keep equity but move cash to US IC2 band. Start earliest 5/8 but needs payroll + benefits lined up. Can we do cross-band exception + split sign-on (relocation reimbursement + retention)?

maria-peopleops: what are the exact target numbers for the US band? and any relocation amount expected? also will they be on US payroll day 1 or via EOR for first pay?

cara-recruiter: Manager wants base ~$125k, bonus 10%, equity unchanged. Relocation estimate from candidate = $8k. Preference: sign-on = half relocation reimbursement + retention lump sum. They can be PEO'd for first 2 pays if needed.

lisa-comp: Comp check: IC2 median $130k in SF. $125k base is borderline but fine with a retention sign-on to hit market comp. We have two policy wrinkles: 1) cross-region band uplift requires comp exception if base increases >20% vs original; 2) relocation reimbursements are processed separately and not grossed-up by default. For urgency we can bundle a one-time retention payment up to $30k as exception with exec sign-off.

ashley-hrbp: Benefits note: if they start before the 1st of month, benefits eligibility depends on enrolment cutoff. Need to confirm payroll start date to avoid delay in medical coverage. Also CA new-hire forms and state tax withholding need to be completed before first pay.

rahul-legal: Legal: relocation reimbursements sometimes create taxable income depending on grossing rules. If we keep relocation as reimbursement (receipts required) it's different than a retention bonus. If the candidate insists on non-taxable, we'd need a gross-up which requires stronger justification.

cara-recruiter: Proposed final comp pack: base $125k, one-time retention sign-on $20k (taxed), relocation reimbursement up to $8k (receipts), bonus 10%, equity 0.15%. Start 5/8. Candidate prefers to see final offer by 5/1.

lisa-comp: That looks workable. Exception required because uplift >20% from EUR baseline once converted. I can draft exception memo with the numbers and rationale (market, relocation, immediate project need). Please include payroll conversion plan (PEO -> direct) and benefits onboarding timing.

maria-peopleops: Routing: people-ops -> comp -> legal -> COO for exec ratify. I will schedule an emergency quick-review 5/1 11:00 PT. If approved we will update offer and DocuSign same day.

cara-recruiter: will ask manager to sign brief note on urgent coverage and sprint impact. Also I'll confirm candidate ok with receipts for relocation and taxed retention.

ashley-hrbp: I'll prepare checklist for new-hire CA forms and benefits enrollment steps; note: if payroll cut-off missed, first pay could be delayed by one cycle. We should aim for direct payroll start 5/8 and submit forms by 5/3.

rahul-legal: OK to proceed with memo. If retention payment > $15k we typically ask for exec sign-off and a short risk note for tax gross-up refusal. Fine to proceed as taxed retention + reimbursed relocation.

lisa-comp: I'll draft memo now and loop in recruiting + HRBP. Final figures in memo: base $125k / retention $20k / relocation up to $8k (receipts) / bonus 10% / eq 0.15%.

maria-peopleops: Confirmed emergency review 2023-05-01 11:00 PT (thread id 1871234567-EXC). Everyone please review memo by EOD today.

cara-recruiter: thanks all. I'll message candidate to hold 5/8 pending sign-off. :pray:
